title: VISION HUB Orion Lib
features:
VisionHub Script Features
1. Profile ID Prompt

GUI popup asks for your Roblox profile ID.

Validates ID against workspace.Tycoons.

Prevents running if invalid.

2. Auto-Collect ATM

Teleports to your Tycoon ATM’s CollectTrigger.

Waits safely (task.wait(0.7)) before restoring character position.

Collects automatically on button press.

3. Auto-Buy System

Cash Only: Buys buttons that cost in-game cash.

Medallion Only: Buys buttons that cost medallions.

Rebirth Only: Buys rebirth-locked buttons.

Skips Robux buttons (detects “R$”, “Robux”, or Robux icon).

Configurable delay slider (0.1s – 3s).

Background loop scans all purchase buttons and auto-touches them.

4. Auto-Rob System

Works on Gas Station and MaxiMart (Supermarket).

Checks if stores are active (light sensor turns lime green).

Requires a gun equipped (prevents starting unarmed).

Safe teleport system (TweenService + offset) prevents falling.

Robs tills, fires prompts automatically.

Collects dropped cash, with max carry capacity.

Configurable Max Hold (default = 5).

Status label shows live updates:

“Ready (cap)”

“Robbing…”

“Inactive”

“Done (x/y)”

“Returned to base”

5. Rebirth Tracking

Tab shows current rebirth count.

“Check Rebirth” button reads Player.SharedData.Rebirths.

Updates label dynamically.

6. UI System

Built with Orion UI Library.

Tabs:

Main: Tycoon ID, Auto-Collect ATM.

AutoBuy: Delay slider, 3 toggles (Cash, Medallion, Rebirth).

Auto-Rob: Store checks, autorob buttons, max hold config.

Necessities: Current rebirth tracker.

Notifications for each major action (success, fail, warnings).

7. Safety + Usability

All teleports are “smooth” or “safe” with 2-step offset.

Bag capacity detection (prevents over-collect).

Error handling (missing Tycoon, missing ATM, inactive store).

Protects GUI in exploit environments (syn.protect_gui, gethui).
